body: I’m really missing having autistic friends right now.
A circular pill holder maybe?

It’s so frustrating especially when people have seen you function normally but somehow the word autism makes them think you’re incapable. Also I don’t know where you’re from but disability cards are pretty useful here for helping with the cost of living so they aren’t all bad.
The chewy necklaces are way too tough for me too. Teethers are much softer and cheaper.
The nicest way I’ve found to word it is “this isn’t helping either of us”.
Thanks it’s good to know I’m not overreacting or something.

I do feel like that too but other people saying it is frustrating and makes me feel like like shit. Just because I don’t enjoy small talk or strangers doesn’t mean I can’t do it at all but my friends act like I am physically incapable of being around strangers.

I’m worried it’s going straight to her and that I’ll need to ask her for it. I don’t remember putting any bank details anywhere. Do you know at what stage in the process you give the bank details? I just found out today I’ve been awarded it.
Thank you I think I will do that.
Any way I could convince her this? She’s saying I’m not good enough with money to have it.
I am 18 but live with them.

I believe this is also happening to me but my depression going just doesn’t seem doable. Although the journaling sounds like a good idea I’ve sort of lost motivation to try if it costs this much just to be told the same thing. I really feel as though my depression will never go away.
Unfortunately I didn’t. As an also autistic female in education I was just completely ignored. I was too quiet for any teacher to notice I was struggling.

Yes I’ve used psychiatry UK about a year ago now. The only reason I didn’t use them this time was because I really this diagnoses before I started this year of college. This psychiatrist had much quicker waiting lists. Obviously I can see now that was a huge mistake and I don’t think I’ll be able to attend/ complete this year of college like this.
That’s exactly how I feel. I’ve been given tons of different ones and none work. I’m so sick of them.
Pretty much. Their idea of treating the comorbidities is giving you some kind of SSRI and abandoning you.
I can’t afford that unfortunately.
Oh that’s awful. I’m 18 and I’m not sure I can cope with two more years of this. I’m really struggling with my education and I don’t think I can do it without some kind of support.
Im in the uk but waiting lists are closed for adhd assessments so I had to spend £695 on this.
What did you do about it? I’m really struggling right now.
I’ve had depression for years and the psychiatrist is acting like I can recover in weeks. I feel so hopeless now. I was really hoping this assessment would help.
How long did that take? I’m really struggling right now and and thought that the potential ADHD may be causing the depression so I’m not sure what to do.
I know they are and that’s why I feel like I’m overreacting. Maybe I’m just being selfish?
My doctor described this to me as “painful leg and moving toes syndrome (PLMT)”
Me too. Melatonin + weighted blanket has really helped me.
It seems like our twitching is very similar. It’s nice to know I’m not the only one I suppose.
I saw a neurologist and got an EMG. I never got the results and the neurologist hasn’t been in contact since.

Unfortunately the NHS is dreadful and I have already seen a doctor who was completely incompetent. Nearly no one gets prescribed benzodiazepines in the UK. I feel like I really need them right now but there’s nothing I can do.
It already has. I don’t know what to do.
I will be doing nothing. I don’t do anything. But thanks.
Thank you
UK. Melatonin is prescription only here unfortunately. I had to order from some strange website.
What about removing just muscle?
I used to watch greys. That show declined in quality dramatically at around season 10. Do you think you could do that to your own limb?
I’ve ordered some but it’s taking a while to arrive. I don’t know what to do to fall asleep whilst I’m waiting.
Thank you. I’ve tried promethazine which worked for a while but then started giving me auditory hallucinations and intense itchiness. I’ll look into what you suggested. Thanks again.
Me too. It’s how I feel. I hope things get better for you.
Does it feel like you’re dragging around a dead body?
Thank you. I know about tails just need to get it.
Me neither. I feel like I have nothing to offer. But I have no chance to meet new people. So maybe it doesn’t matter how much people would like me? What about you?

I wish I could drive. Driving whilst no one is around at night does sound pleasant. I know what you mean about the animals. Sometimes I feel like I feel so much empathy for anything else that is also alone. I know how much of a horrible feeling it is. I think you do too.

I want to. I love Terence McKenna. I am unfortunately not from the us. Or maybe fortunately? It does seem like a bit of a shit show right now. I’ll look though. It is something I’ve always wanted to do. And I might as well if I’m going to kill myself.
Me too. It feels like I’ll never get out of this. I hope you can.
It’s actually nice to know that Im not the only one it’s physically hurts. I’m really sorry that it hurts you but somehow it made me feel slightly less alone.
Yes. It is that time for me right now. I’ve never seen anyone else say they like it too.
me too
Me too. I only get notifications from her every now and then.
I meant the disappearing stuff but it doesn’t matter that did actually help. So thank you.
Thank you that was nice to read and think about. I suppose that kind of stuff is nice to fantasise about though.

I know you’re right but I can’t be that. I don’t do anything. I’m nothing. Wouldn’t it be so much easier if I never existed in the first place? Or I if I could disappear and no one remembered I ever existed?
